SELECT group_value, FROM ( SELECT proj_worklog.*, AS group_value
) filtered GROUP BY group_value ORDER BY CASE WHEN group_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, group_value

SELECT work_item_id, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'ESTIMATED' THEN hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS estimated_hours, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'ACTUAL' THEN hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS actual_hours FROM proj_worklog WHERE deleted = 0 AND work_item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY work_item_id

SELECT wi.sprint_id, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(w.hours), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS actual_hours FROM proj_worklog w JOIN proj_work_item wi ON wi.id = w.work_item_id AND wi.project_id = w.project_id AND wi.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND wi.deleted = 0 WHERE w.project_id = #{projectId} AND w.type = 'ACTUAL' AND w.deleted = 0 AND wi.sprint_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wi.sprint_id
